definitions.explanation: seeing something incorrectly or mistaking one thing for another

examples.japanese: {見|み}{間違|まちが}い⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I thought I was seeing things.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見|み}{間違|まちが}い⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Isn't that just your eyes playing tricks?

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗|くら}くて→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見|み}{間違|まちが}い⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: It was dark, and I mistook someone for another person and called out to the wrong person.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{見|み}{間違|まちが}い combines ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to see) + ⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧ (mistake). Note that unlike other ～⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧ compounds, this one doesn't have the connecting い.

USAGE:
- ⟦{人違|ひとちが}い→人違い：19449_hitochigai⟧ - mistaking someone for another person
- ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ - dark places
- ⟦{遠|とお}く→遠い：00529_tooi⟧ - from a distance
- ⟦{似|に}ている→似る：01159_niru⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ - similar-looking things

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{見|み}{間違|まちが}える→見間違える：21106_mimachigaeru⟧ (verb) - to mistake (visually)
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{錯覚|さっかく}→錯覚：06748_sakkaku⟧ - optical illusion
- ⟦{人違|ひとちが}い→人違い：19449_hitochigai⟧ - mistaking someone's identity

RELATED ～{間違|まちが}い WORDS:
- ⟦{聞|き}き{間違|まちが}い→聞き間違い：08578_kikimachigai⟧ - mishearing
- ⟦{言|い}い{間違|まちが}い→言い間違い：08579_iimachigai⟧ - slip of the tongue
- ⟦{読|よ}み{間違|まちが}い→読み間違い：08581_yomimachigai⟧ - misreading
